items.title: Vince DiMartino interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, January 8, 2025
items.q: And then the thing with Glenn Drewes and me... We were all close.

ctx.x: DeUlio. Large D, small E, Large I — L-I-O. U-I-L-O. DeUlio. And I mean I think of him almost every day, still. Because he was just remarkable, a remarkable person you know. And he would say — anytime I had time I was in the band room practicing. During lunch I would eat lunch in 10 minutes and I’d go over to the band room and practice. And that’s just what I did. And he had one of those rotating lesson schedules so that he could have the groups of kids that played the same part, he could work with them and teach…
